_about: Ultra+ (Nexus mod 10490) recommendations for Cyberpunk 2077, from the Ultra+ team's page https://theultraplace.com/games/cyberpunk2077/ (its source: gitlab.com/ultra-plus/ultraplus-wiki, _games/Cyberpunk2077.md, commit e50461d of 2026-10-07). The app can refresh the four site lists from that page; extra_conflicts and collection come only from this file. RedHotTools is from Ultra+'s own startup check (lib/Engine.lua, CheckIncompatibleMods), not the site.
